title: Products
attention: {count, plural, =1 {1 product needs a look} other {# products need a look}}

empty.title: No products yet
empty.description: Add what you keep a stock of and the log starts counting.

fault.nothingMoved: Nothing has been filled in to record
fault.purchaseNotPositive: A purchase adds to the stock and cannot be negative
fault.removalNotNegative: Servings and waste take from the stock
fault.volumeOnUnitProduct: This product is counted in units and has no volume of its own
fault.correctionNeedsTarget: A correction has to name the row it corrects
fault.calibrationNoVolume: The bottle's volume has to be more than nothing
fault.openBottlesFirst: Open bottles have to go first. Take them along, or leave the sealed one
fault.notThatManyOpen: There are not that many open bottles at that level
fault.notThatManySealed: There are not that many sealed bottles
fault.levelsOnReturnOnly: A level is set when the bottle comes back, not when it is taken out
fault.moreThanWentOut: More bottles than went out. Check the count
fault.moreThanOnShelf: There are only {count} on the shelf
fault.moreBottlesThanWentOut: More bottles home than went out
fault.eanRequired: The barcode is needed. Scan it or type it in (8–14 digits)
fault.abvRequired: The strength is needed for the restaurangrapport
fault.sizeRequired: The volume is needed for the report's litres
fault.costRequired: The cost price is needed before the stock can be valued

products.removedWithLog: The product was removed, and {count, plural, =1 {1 movement} other {# movements}} in the log with it.
products.removeDescription: Nothing has been booked on this product, so nothing else changes when it goes.
products.removeUsed: {count, plural, =1 {1 movement} other {# movements}} in the log go with the product: deliveries, stocktakes and whatever was booked on an occasion. The stock value is recomputed without them, and the purchased volumes behind a restaurangrapport already filed can no longer be reproduced. This cannot be undone.
products.dialogHint: A name, a barcode, a strength, a size and a price are needed before the product can be saved. The rest is optional.

field.name: Name
field.eanHint: Lets the product be scanned in the cellar.
field.systembolagetIdInvalid: No article number in there. Paste the product's link from systembolaget.se, or type just the digits.
field.tagsHint: Free labels to find the product by: whisky, cognac, vodka. Optional.
field.tagSearch: Search, or type a new one…
field.tagTooLong: That tag is too long, at most {max} characters
field.shelfLifeHint: Months from delivery. Beer is usually 9, cider 21. Leave empty for anything that does not go off, such as spirits.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.subtitle: Point the camera at the barcode on the tin or the bottle.
scan.hint: Hold the code inside the frame.
scan.unknown: No product has that barcode. Add the product first.
scan.noCamera: The camera could not be started. Type the code below instead.
scan.needsHttps: The camera needs a secure connection (https). Open the page over https, or type the code below.
scan.noPermission: The camera is blocked. Allow camera access for this site in your browser settings.
scan.noCameraFound: No camera was found on this device.
scan.codeHint: Type the code, or fire it in with a handheld reader and press enter.
scan.noReader: The barcode reader could not be loaded. Type the code instead.

notice.worth: The stock's value goes up by {value}, from the product's purchase price.
notice.noCostPrice: This product has no purchase price, so the delivery goes on the shelf worth nothing. Fill the price in on the product first if the stock value is to be right.

delivery.title: Record a delivery
delivery.counts: {count, plural, =0 {No products yet} =1 {1 product} other {# products}}
delivery.noteHint: Goes on every row. An invoice number, say.
delivery.scan: Scan a barcode. It adds the product. If the delivery already has it, you jump to its row
delivery.failed: That row could not be booked.
delivery.saved: {count, plural, =1 {1 row booked} other {# rows booked}}
delivery.unsaved: {count, plural, =1 {1 row waiting to be saved} other {# rows waiting to be saved}}
delivery.discardMessage: {count, plural, =1 {1 filled-in row} other {# filled-in rows}} will be removed. Nothing has been booked, so there is no getting it back.

stocktake.title: Stocktake
stocktake.lead: Type what is actually on the shelf. The difference from the log is booked as an adjustment.
stocktake.difference: Differs from the log ({sealed} sealed). The adjustment goes into the log.
stocktake.agrees: Agrees with the log. Nothing to adjust.
stocktake.noteHint: Say why it differs, if you know.

spoilage.title: Write off
spoilage.lead: For what broke or went out of date in the cellar. The quantity comes off the shelf and the stock value is written down.
spoilage.worth: The stock's value is written down by roughly {value}.
spoilage.noValue: This product is worth nothing on the shelf, so the write-off is recorded without an amount.
spoilage.noteHint: Say what happened, if you can.
spoilage.atEvent: Something broken at a pub is booked as spill on that occasion, not here.

product.noCostPrice: No purchase price set, so the stock value comes to nothing
product.impossible: The balance does not add up. Take a stocktake to correct it.
product.eventsHint: What the product did at each occasion. If somebody changed a night's figures, it is behind the arrow.
product.noEvents: The product has not been out to an occasion yet.
product.cellarHint: What has been done with the product in the cellar, most recently entered first.
product.noCellar: Nothing has been booked in the cellar on this product yet.

event.title: Occasions
event.empty: No occasions yet. Create one before taking stock out.
event.newHint: An occasion is a night or an event. Everything taken out and brought back is booked against it.
event.saveFailed: The occasion could not be created.
event.editHint: Changing the date moves everything booked on the occasion to the new date, and the stock value is recomputed.
event.editFailed: The occasion could not be saved.
event.removeDescription: Nothing is booked on this occasion, so nothing else changes when it goes.
event.removeUsed: {count, plural, =1 {1 movement} other {# movements}} across {products, plural, =1 {1 product} other {# products}} go with the occasion. What went out comes back onto the shelf, and what came home part-used leaves it. The stock value is recomputed without the night. This cannot be undone.
event.removedWithLog: The occasion was removed, and {count, plural, =1 {1 movement} other {# movements}} in the log with it.
event.nothing: Nothing has been booked on this occasion yet. Add a product below.
event.movements: {count, plural, =1 {1 movement in the log} other {# movements in the log}}

field.name: Name
field.nameHint: What you call the night. The name is picked from a list afterwards, so the spelling only has to be settled once.

sheet.title: Out, in and spill
sheet.failed: That could not be booked. The figures are being re-read.

locked.nothingOnShelf: Nothing was at that level when the occasion began. What you have brought back tonight cannot go out again. It would not count for anything either way.
locked.nothingOut: Nothing has gone out on this occasion yet, so nothing can come back or break.

sheet.noMatch: Nothing on this occasion matches “{text}”. Add it on an empty row below.
sheet.scan: Scan a barcode. It adds the product. If the occasion already has it, you jump to its row
sheet.unsaved: {count, plural, =1 {1 cell waiting to be saved} other {# cells waiting to be saved}}
sheet.unsavedWithFaults: {count, plural, =1 {1 cell waiting} other {# cells waiting}} – {faults, plural, =1 {1 cannot be booked} other {# cannot be booked}}
sheet.discardTitle: Clear what has been filled in?
sheet.discardMessage: {count, plural, =1 {1 changed cell} other {# changed cells}} will be removed. Nothing has been booked, so there is no getting it back.

entry.title: Correct the row
entry.hint: {kind}, {date}. Type what it should have been. We work out the difference.
entry.qtyHint: Says {was} now. Zero removes the row entirely.
entry.unchanged: The figure is unchanged, so there is nothing to save
entry.failed: The row could not be changed.

asOf.label: As of
asOf.notice: The figures show the stock as it stood on {date}. Movements after that date are left out.

revalue.title: Recalculate the stock value?
revalue.description: Every product's log is read through again and its value rewritten to what the rules give. Purchase prices are left alone: each row carries the price it was booked at.
revalue.settled: Nothing to recalculate. The stock value is already what the rules give.
revalue.failed: Could not recalculate the stock value.

stats.title: Stock statistics
stats.chartAlt: The stock value over time, stacked by drink type.
stats.flowHint: What was bought in and what was got through, at purchase value. The four divide the period between them: checkouts count net, so what came back unopened is not consumed, and spillage stands on its own. Adjustments is what stocktakes and corrections moved the shelf by, so a negative figure is stock missing that nothing else here accounts for.
stats.mixHint: Litres and value per drink type, at the end of the period.
stats.moversHint: What left the shelf in the period, and what is left of it.

expiry.rowHint: Delivered {delivered}. Keeps until roughly {date}, going by the product's shelf life.
expiry.checkedDone: Noted that you looked. We will ask again in a while.
expiry.title: Best before
expiry.hint: One row per delivery that could still be down there. The dates are worked out from the product's shelf life, not read off the packaging. Go and look, and tick off one row at a time.
expiry.none: No deliveries to keep an eye on.
